import numpy as np,json
for name in ['initial','approach2','grip5','turn_try1','push_close','push_try1','push_lower3','push_try2']:
 try:
  rgb=np.array(Image.open(f'/app/output/{name}/last/robot0_agentview_right.jpg'))
  d=np.load(f'/app/output/{name}/depth_robot0_agentview_right.npy')[0].astype(float)
  m=json.load(open(f'/app/output/{name}/meta.json'));C=m['cameras']['robot0_agentview_right'];K=np.array(C['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(C['cam2world_gl'])
 except Exception as e: print(name,e);continue
 # object roi determined from rendered imgs; static right view but subtle robot occlusion
 yy,xx=np.mgrid[120:165,122:150];px=rgb[yy,xx];dep=d[yy,xx]
 dark=px.max(axis=2)<90
 rays=np.stack([(xx-160)/K[0,0],-(yy-120)/K[1,1],-np.ones_like(xx)],axis=-1)*dep[...,None]
 xyz=rays@T[:3,:3].T+T[:3,3]
 mask=dark&(dep>1.1)&(dep<1.6)&(xyz[:,:,2]>.90)&(xyz[:,:,2]<1.01)

 hi=q[:,:2].mean(0) if len(q) else np.array([np.nan,np.nan])
 v=hi-center;ang=np.degrees(np.arctan2(v[1],v[0]))
 print(name,'N',len(P),len(q),'center',np.round(center,4),'hi',np.round(hi,4),'vec',np.round(v,4),'angle',round(ang,1))

+"""RoboCasa TurnOnSinkFaucet single-episode controller record.

+contact strategy used during the live episode.  Set ROBOCASA_EXECUTE=1 only

+record cannot accidentally submit extra actions to the live run.

+    row = np.array([dx, dy, dz, drx, dry, drz, grip,
+                    base_x, base_y, base_yaw, torso, hybrid], dtype=np.float64)
+    return np.repeat(row[None, :], n, axis=0)
+
+
+def send(robot, rows, note):
+    return robot.submit("ee_delta", rows, interpolate="hold", cameras=CAMERAS,
+                        include_depth=True, video="frames", note=note)
+

+
